integrate.idea: ONE registrar module `deliverables_register.py` (stdlib only): `append_row(effort_dir, what, where, date, step)` under `paths.WRITE_LOCK`, atomic write, idempotent on (what, where) by scanning existing rows; resolves the effort dir (effort folder if the run has one, else project root) and the active step via `steward_campaign.read_map` 'doing'. All three finish hooks call it.

Wire the three finish points to the registrar: (a) `gandalf.run_gandalf` at the terminal index write (gandalf.py:~1707) → Where = `/report/<pid>/gandalf/<run_id>` or `/artifact/<pid>?path=<report_rel>`; (b) `job_runner` on the STATUS_DONE transition for research/plan lanes → Where = `/report/<pid>/<lane>/<job_id>`; (c) Foreman wave GO detected from the execution-log/wave record → Where = `/artifact/<pid>?path=<EXECUTION-LOG rel>`. Each passes the lane-appropriate 'what' label and the date.

Extend `read_deliverables` (steward_campaign.py:1045) with a route branch: if the Where cell's first token matches `^/(report|artifact)/`, set `openable=True`, `route=<token>`, `path=None`; everything else keeps the existing in-effort realpath containment. `delivRow` in shared.js opens `route` in a new window (token appended the same way other cockpit links do) when present, else the `/api/deliverable-file` stream as today — so the tile AND `stepDelivLine` both get the link with zero outline-side changes.

`run:` marker parsing in the same parser: a Where/How cell containing `run: <command>` yields `run=<command>` (plain string, no evaluation); `delivRow` renders a second anchor 'Run ▶' beside the open link only when `run` is present. Documents without `run:` are untouched.

New token-gated `POST /api/rnd/run_deliverable_terminal {project_id, command}` → `terminal_session.start_session(project_id, 'general', cwd=<project tree>)` then set the command as `pending_paste` via the existing v10 latch (no trailing newline, greet-gated flush, once-only); returns the session record so the cockpit opens it in the normal session window (killable, resumable like any session). Server-side allowlist: the command must be the exact `run:` text of an existing register row for that project (re-read from disk), so the endpoint never runs arbitrary POSTed shell.

Idempotency + retry test: run the registrar twice with the same (what, where) and on a resumed Gandalf run → exactly one row; a cancelled/failed run writes NO row (only ok runs register — a failed Gandalf is not a deliverable).

Negative-containment tests as the STUB GATE: Where cells `/artifact/<pid>?path=../../x`, `http://evil`, `../outside.md` all render as text (or 401/404 on open), and `run:` text with `<script>` is shown as plain text; plus the stub-PTY assertion that a staged command's bytes end without `\n` and never re-flush on a second attach.

Playwright sign-off on a real project: trigger a Gandalf run, assert the report link appears under its roadmap step in the plan outline AND in the deliverables tile, click each → new window with the report; add a `run: python -c "print('hi')"` row → click Run → screenshot the general terminal with the command sitting unsent, then Enter. Two-step follow-on (Oranges): once rows exist, the status look-through Doing row can surface 'report ready → link' by reading the newest register row for the active step — no new data needed.
